summary: LZ Technology Holdings Ltd (NYSE: LZ) filed a Form 6-K on June 5, 2026, reporting the resignation of director Ms. Li Zhang due to personal reasons, effective immediately. The board appointed Ms. Huijuan Xu as independent director and committee chair/member to fill the vacancy. Ms. Xu brings over 20 years of international shipping/logistics experience, currently serving as Senior Sales Executive at CMA CGM. The Board determined Ms. Xu meets independence and financial literacy standards under exchange rules. No financial terms or advisor involvement disclosed. This event is a routine director resignation and replacement, not a special situation. Watch for any further board changes or strategic shifts.
